about_the_game:
Dig deeper into another dimension!

If you wanna learn more about A. Wandereye, Planck's ecosystem and the development of the game, this DLC is for you! Read all about Wandereye's discoveries on her Liquidemon page, Wandereye's Writings - a 90's-themed blog! Basically everything you encounter will be added to her website with her thoughts that you can read. Now you'll get to know what she thinks about that weird plant you saw earlier! Does she like it? Does she dislike it? Guess you'll just have to buy this and read about it to find out!

This DLC allows you to access all entries you've found in the Fourmipedia, totaling at over 100 if you get all of them. After accomplishing certain things, you may even get to read our thoughts on the game's things too... (DEV COMMENTARY - and maybe... something more?)

Why Wandereye's Writings?

Fourmiworld by itself is available for free, and is playable as a complete experience without any gameplay or parts of the map locked behind paywalls. Our primary concern as devs is to have the game accessible to as many people as possible. If you wanna play Fourmiworld, you should be able to.

BUT, the truth is we did both spend significant time on this game... and neither of us really... HAVE much money. So if you want to support us, that's what this DLC is for. After Steam's cut, all your money is going to two lovers making games.

If you're a gamedev or artist that's interested in how we approached dev, or just a total fourmihead that wants to know more about everything, we think you'll enjoy giving it a read!
